firstPlayerRule: The player whose Clan has the lowest-numbered Starting Honor Rank takes the first Mandate Turn. Their Clan starts at the top of the Honor track.
clarifications: Seat players clockwise in increasing Starting Honor Rank. The seating order stays fixed.
This identifies the first Political Mandate turn; the opening Tea Ceremony is for players to negotiate alliances.
